ov: Small reef fish of the warm Indo-Pacific that live among sea anemones, sheltered by the stinging tentacles. In return they defend, clean and feed the anemone.
rg: Warm and tropical waters of the Indian and Pacific oceans.
fx: Groups have a strict size order: the female is largest, then the breeding male, then the non-breeders.
